items.title: 18.7.3 Effect of Ligand Exchange on the Colour of Complexes

source_refs.note: Topic 18.7.3 (printed page 26) with Table 18.4 and Quick Check 18.5 (printed page 27). Table 18.4 row 2 prints 'Cu(H2O)6]2+' without its opening bracket; copied as printed.

blocks.text: The exchange of ligands in a complex changes the magnitude of splitting for the metal ion. As a result, the frequency of absorbed light also changes, leading to a change in the observed colour. In each case, the new complex has a different ΔE because the new ligands (NH₃ or Cl⁻) makes more stable complex than the original H₂O ligands, leading to a different absorbed frequency and a different observed colour.
